text:
jenna_ops: FYI vendor Xyla shipped a partial RMA batch for the EU edge pool — 16 H100s + 32 H100 (two AWBs). We need forwarder recon and customs docs before COB. ETA T+3 FRA.
ashok_p: Can you drop the AWBs and serials? I'll check depot capacity.
jenna_ops: AWB1: `XYLA-1001-AB1234567`, AWB2: `XYLA-1001-CD9876543`. Serials pasted to the shared spreadsheet (link).
leah_logistics: forwarding partner (EuroTrans) flagged HS code mismatch on AWB2, holding docs. Need commercial invoice with serial list + value breakdown. Vendor, can you reissue? @vendor-bot any updates?
vendor-bot: Xyla shipment update: AWB XYLA-1001-AB1234567 in transit. Link: https://track.vendor/AB1234567. Commercial invoice uploaded to portal at 2025-06-10T09:12Z.
dmitri_infra: If FRA depot accepts only 16 this round, we should plan staggered intake. Can ops hold a warm lane for the second AWB? Depot capacity is ~20 slots daily.
jenna_ops: Good call. Leah, can you confirm depot booking for Monday morning (slot 07:00-10:00 CET)?
leah_logistics: Booking request sent to FRA depot. They asked for estimated arrival window and contact person. Put `ops-fra@redwood` as contact.
kyle_sourcing: On cost side: vendor proposed to split expedited freight 50/50 since RMA partial was supplier-caused. We should flag ledger changes with accounting. @accounting please advise on PO amendment process.
accounting: We need the vendor credit memo and revised invoice before we commit to cost share. Also tag the original PO: PO-331210.
ashok_p: Also, vendor noted some units are DOA on arrival probability ~1-2%. We should pre-approve immediate depot photos + functional test flow to avoid holdups.
dmitri_infra: Suggest test-run script for depot techs: `run_diag.sh --quick-check --kv-check` and a short acceptance checklist. Upload to FRADepot Confluence page.
leah_logistics: Forwarder ops (fwd_ops), can EuroTrans accept a reconsignment request if customs rejects AWB2? What's the cost delta?
fwd_ops: EuroTrans: reconsignment possible but ~€1,100 per AWB and adds 24-48h. If vendor can correct CI to include serials we avoid reconsignment.
vendor-bot: Vendor note: we can reissue commercial invoice today with serial-level line items and HS code `8471.80`. Will attach updated docs to portal by EOD.
janna_ops: typo — jenna_ops: great, thanks.
ashok_p: Once CI updated, Leah please push docs to forwarder and customs broker. Also request depot to pre-stage test bench and photo checklist.
leah_logistics: On it. I also added an ask: depot wants RMA reference + photos to be uploaded within 2 hours of receipt else they will mark as 'inspection pending' which delays processing.
dmitri_infra: Can we reserve a holdback pool of 8 GPUs in FRA network for hotpatch deliveries? If second AWB delayed, we want to avoid capacity thrash.
kyle_sourcing: We have 4 warm spares in DE region, but not enough for the whole pool. Approve temporary borrow from Dedicated pool? That impacts cost center INF-OPS.
jenna_ops: Approve borrow of up to 8 units for 48h. Tag with `rma-temp-borrow` label. Ops, please record telemetry routing for those instances.
fwd_ops: EuroTrans updated ETA for AWB1: 2025-06-13 05:40 CET, AWB2 pending customs docs.
vendor-bot: Commercial invoice v2 attached: `CI-1755-v2.pdf`. Serial list included.
leah_logistics: CI received and forwarded to broker. Broker says clearance should proceed; keep an eye on VAT treatment and any back-charge.
ashok_p: When AWB1 arrives, depot to run `run_diag.sh` and attach `photo_FRONT.jpg`, `photo_POSE.jpg`, and `serial_scan.json` to ticket. If any unit fails quick-check, vendor to be notified for DOA RMA immediate replacement.
dmitri_infra: Also enable temporary routing policy for these requests: prefer Dedicated fallback with low-latency tag for edge-critical stacks. I'll open the rollout patch.
kyle_sourcing: Can vendor confirm earliest replacement ship date for DOA units? If DOA, we want replacements within T+2.
vendor-bot: Xyla confirms replacements T+2 from DOA confirmation.
accounting: Once credit memo arrives, we can finalize freight split. Reminder to add cost center tags and attach to PO-331210.
leah_logistics: Depot booking confirmed for Monday 07:00-09:00 CET for AWB1. I sent contact details.
jenna_ops: thanks team. I'll coordinate post-arrival triage and summarize next steps into the incident thread. :thumbsup:
ashok_p: small ask — capture the forwarder AWB manifest as a zipped file in the ticket so procurement can reconcile later.
leah_logistics: done, manifest uploaded.
fwd_ops: AWB1 delivered to FRA depot at 2025-06-13 08:18 CET per POD.
jenna_ops: Perfect. Leah, confirm tests started?
leah_logistics: Tests started 08:40 CET. Photo checklist in attachments. 1 unit failed quick-check (serial ends ...77). Raising vendor RMA immediate replacement.
kyle_sourcing: Opening replacement PO amendment now.
dmitri_infra: Nice. Keep an eye on cluster permutations when we swap units — KV caches may need warmup.
jenna_ops: Noted. I'll post a short runbook for cache-warmup after replacement.
accounting: Credit memo received from vendor. Preparing journal entry for freight split.
jenna_ops: Closing loop here: second AWB cleared customs and is inbound with ETA T+2 now. Thanks all for fast turnaround. :party_parrot:
